about: Lookups by address that keep naming only NostrEvent, each with why (ADR graph-operations-foundation/0003 Decision 9). Every other lookup by address names NostrEvent|TapestryNode. tapestry-key-paths.test.js G11 checks this list against the source.

kept.reason: A MERGE, which can't take a label disjunction: the placeholder for an a or b tag's target, made only when the OPTIONAL MATCH by NostrEvent|TapestryNode before it found no node at the address. It stands for an event, so it is a NostrEvent.

A MERGE, which can't take a label disjunction: the imported event itself, at its address. The statement before it adopts an event-less node there (gives it NostrEvent back), so the MERGE lands on that node.

A MERGE, which can't take a label disjunction: the event the signing routes import, at its address. The call before it adopts an event-less node there (gives it NostrEvent back), so the MERGE lands on that node.

A MERGE, which can't take a label disjunction: the event importEventDirect imports, at its address. The call before it adopts an event-less node there (gives it NostrEvent back), so the MERGE lands on that node.
About the event: whether a firmware concept is installed is whether its header event, which firmware install imports from a signed event, is in the graph. A concept header is never event-less.
